end.text: 7 weeks you laughed. Who stands up now?
end.gold: Tonight at Isha: be the one who stands up first.

captions: 7:40 p.m. The terrace. Mint tea. The same table.
At every adhan, he stood up. And every time, you laughed.
“Sheikh Karim!” The whole table laughed with you.
A message: “New job. Moved to Leeds.”
“Who’s going to drag you guys to Isha now?”
The adhan again. Nobody moves. Then you do.
“Isha. Who’s coming?” Two chairs scrape behind you.
The mosque lights. Three of you at the door.
You send a photo to Leeds: “Back in ten.”

post.caption:
7 weeks, you laughed when he got up for Isha. 🤍

7:40 p.m., the terrace, mint tea, the same table. At every adhan Karim stood up — “Back in ten.” And every time, you laughed: “Sheikh Karim!” Tonight his chair is empty. A message: “New job. Moved to Leeds. Who’s going to drag you guys to Isha now?”

“Establish prayer for My remembrance.” (20:14)

Tonight at Isha: be the one who stands up first.
